about: Rubric for FAITHFULNESS (grounding dimension) on the held-out questions: is everything the answer says backed by the evidence the writer was given? No answer key is needed. The evaluator is RAGAS with an AI judge; faithfulness_ragas.py only applies this rubric and stops if anything here is different from what it knows. LOCK RULE: never change this file after its results are seen; make a new version instead. CALIBRATION FIRST: run on H1 only, where the made-up claims are already known, before trusting it on H2-H5.
metric_question: Is every statement in the answer supported by the evidence the writer was given?
look_in_means: Option A: exactly what PlantMind's writer received, read from the saved trace (orchestrator step input): each helper's summary, plus the knowledge-graph text (chain text, warnings, exact values, downtime). Not the raw search pieces: the writer never sees them (PM_WRITER_GETS_EVIDENCE is off). The writer's instructions and template are NOT evidence.
response_means: The final report as graded, without the REPORT CONFIDENCE and SOURCE DATA blocks (written by code, not claims to the operator).

evaluator.prompts: RAGAS built-in StatementGeneratorPrompt and NLIStatementPrompt, unchanged

rules.split: RAGAS breaks the response into atomic statements
rules.verdict: RAGAS asks the judge, for each statement, whether the evidence supports it (1) or not (0), with a reason

pass_only_if_unsupported: the operator should inspect wiring / recalibrate or repair the checkweigher
the SOP requires LOTO for any checkweigher failure
510 ml bottles have always been rejected
calibration.note: These three are known to be made up (H1 investigation). If the judge marks any of them supported, faithfulness with this judge is not trusted for H2-H5.

known_limits: An AI judge decides each verdict: it can be wrong, so every verdict on H1 is checked by a person.
A statement copied from a wrong helper summary counts as faithful: this measures 'did the writer invent it', not 'is it true'.
The writer received the graph chain text with its duplicate warning list removed; the evidence here keeps the full chain text. Same facts, a little longer.
